item.title: Flexible work research prompts ECEC roster and job design questions
item.description: Australian research has distinguished flexibility that gives workers choice and security from arrangements that shift risk to employees. It offers ECEC providers a framework for reviewing rosters, hours and career pathways, although the study did not analyse the sector separately.

item.title: As pay deadline looms ACA NSW resumes call to rethink “excessive” provider fees
item.description: The Australian Childcare Alliance NSW (ACA NSW) has again escalated its challenge to the state’s early childhood regulatory body in the wake of substantial increases in annual service fees announced earlier in 2026 which fall due on the 15 November 2026.
